query: Foi corrigido o bug do gate em que duas branches pro mesmo bead faziam a versao incompleta mergear antes do hold gate:needs-human chegar a tempo?
Ja teve um bug em que o gate revisava so uma fracao do diff (truncado tipo head -2000) mas carimbava a revisao como 100% completa?
Existe um bug conhecido em que um FAIL do gate nao travava o commit, e um run posterior acabava mergeando o mesmo commit reprovado?
What caused a re-queued gate marker after a quota-stop or dead-reviewer requeue to get false-FAILed on the next Phase C sweep?
Did we fix the gate-done branch regex that truncates dotted sub-bead IDs like ps-8iuu.4 down to ps-8iuu?
Has the bug been fixed where Pilot dispatches two different workers to the same bead because dedup doesn't recognize fix/<bead>-* branch naming?
What was wrong with Pilot's dispatch filter that made it treat next-action:<crew>-constroi labels as a blocker, starving approved WA stories?
Did we already fix auto-refino re-scanning stories that have an explicit hold from another authority, like blocked-on:* or pool:refused:* labels?
What was the hardcoded magic-number bug in the gate-selfheal drift-guard selftest that went red every time a new needs-human site was added?
Was there an incident where git add on the shared HQ tree accidentally committed another agent's uncommitted work, bypassing the gate?
Foi corrigido o bug do Pregao Triar em que a pill de nome do WhatsApp caia no fallback formal em vez de mostrar 'nao revelado' quando nao havia reveal?
What was the P0 bug where tick_unconfirmed collapsed two different send outcomes into one state, causing duplicate sends to the same lead on retry?
Was there a bug where screen_ts_to_str fabricated the wrong date, turning yesterday's chat bubble into today's and starving the response cursor?
Did we fix the duplicate-contacts bug in classifications where the same person is stored twice, once with and once without the leading 9 digit?
What caused campaign_dashboard to leak file descriptors and fall back to _DEFAULTS with no production_send_backend, leaving the on-device roster empty?
What broke the priority-pill drawer in version 2.8.8 so that clicking a card wouldn't open it anymore?
Did we already fix the painel Aprovadas column showing beads that weren't actually dispatchable by the Pilot?
Did we build a single unified phone-number resolver shared between inbound_capture and inbound_sweep instead of two separate ones?
Was there a bug where the on-screen parser was blind to audio messages, undercounting audio replies compared to notification-based detection?
Did we ship the Pregao TRIAR mode to production for both desktop and mobile?
